splitDefinitions.dev_val: Development validation: dataset split "val" and not listed in pipeline_tuning/validation.json. Used for model selection; not unseen.
splitDefinitions.final_test: validation.json `finalTest`: verified recordings with no recorded exposure, reserved until promotion. Excluded from packages, scoring and tuning.
splitDefinitions.final_test_candidate: validation.json `finalTestCandidates`: provisional final-test recordings (D-015 §2). Protected exactly like final_test while venue/session provenance and prior exposure are verified; NOT yet the final test.
splitDefinitions.legacy_holdout: validation.json `holdout`: frozen recordings (D-002) with recorded prior exposure (test-set scoring, tuner reports). Not an unseen final test.
splitDefinitions.tune: validation.json `tune`: pipeline settings are searched on these. Also in the detector's val split.
